research.notes: Intake: not stated on the page, so unknown. The loan is 'repayable term loans at an interest rate equal to the Bank of Canada rate + 0.5%'; no maximum or cost share is stated. The eligibility list says applicants 'must normally' meet it; the page's 'fewer than 100 employees and less than $10 million in sales' gives employees lt 100 and revenue lt 10000000 ('sales' read as yearly revenue; reviewers, check that reading). 'Strategic sector as defined by JGRD' is not a list on the page, so it's a check-this-yourself item, not an industry rule. The summary also says 'The fund is also available to businesses which have export potential'; I did not turn that into a rule or an exception to the strategic-sector item. The page says 'Please consult with the JGRD office near you' but lists no regional numbers, so the department's regional office phones are quoted from the Business Growth Program page (same department, official page), saved as a second source and labelled as such (DECISIONS #18). The application form is a PDF and was not read.
